tools.name: get_rates
tools.description: Latest or dated reference rates. Provider rates retain published digits on their own base. Returns rate records; if any provider fails, returns {rates,errors} preserving successes. Retry only failed providers.

tools.name: convert
tools.description: Convert money using a reference rate. Returns {amount,currency}, rounded to the target's minor units (8 significant figures for metals/crypto). Set details for the rate and effective date too; identity conversions have rate 1 and date null.

tools.name: list_currencies
tools.description: Find currency, metal and crypto codes by code or name. Returns {code:name}; omit query for all, including historical currencies.

tools.name: list_providers
tools.description: Find rate providers with keys, rate types, base currencies, frequency and coverage dates. Filters combine; omit for all. Use a key as provider in convert or get_rates; a provider publishing several series lists datasets, whose keys select one.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_rates" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Latest or a single day's exchange rates. The raw-rate companion to `convert`. With `provider`, published rates from one or more institutions: on its own base the digits are as published, with the date they took effect." → after: "Latest or dated reference rates. Provider rates retain published digits on their own base. Returns rate records; if any provider fails, returns {rates,errors} preserving successes. Retry only failed providers."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
